strategies.callout_id: 用分段估计解决几个序列的极限问题#3
strategies.strategy_name_en: Replace by a Better-Behaved Approximation with Controlled Error
strategies.summary_en: If one can find a modified quantity $S_n'$ whose asymptotic expansion is easier to derive than that of $S_n$, then it is enough to compare $S_n$ and $S_n'$. When the total discrepancy is controlled by $O(g(n))$, at the target precision, the two quantities have the same final asymptotic expansion.
strategies.applicability: Use this when a direct asymptotic analysis is difficult, but a suitably bounded approximation, comparison, or squeezing produces a simpler expression with the same asymptotic accuracy.
strategies.callout_body: 如果你发现一个$S_n'$其形式比$S_n$更好得到渐近展开，比如说对$S_n$做某种放缩，只要放缩整体的误差是被$O(g(n))$控制起来的(这里表示目标误差精度)，那么最终的渐近展开是相同的。
